tile.compliance_2025: In the first year of its new policy, nearly four in five Gates-funded publications complied, most without the foundation paying a publishing fee.
tile.preprints_lmic_2025: Almost two in three Gates-funded preprints in 2025 had an author based in a low- or middle-income country, up from just over half in 2024 and in line with the foundation’s focus on global health research funding.
tile.head_start_median_2025: By promoting preprints, the foundation helps findings reach others sooner: in 2025, preprinted research was public a median of 7.6 months before its journal article.
